_comment: Runnable (system-1) conformance spec for dealer-flow-projection, projected from .spire/clusters/tech/contracts/dealer-flow-projection/INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md '## Conformance spec' into the flat schema interface_conformance.py executes ({method,path,path_params,query,body,required}). Standalone convention (mirrors byo-ai-key / ai-rec-backtest-orders), NOT folded into ticker-load-experience.json. The feature's ONLY wire delta is the additive nested field market_state.dealer_flow_projection (object|null), which is OPTIONAL/NULLABLE by design: present-and-typed when the chain yields charm/vanna, but legitimately null (whole object) or with a null limb when an aggregate is unavailable or no monthly OPEX exists. It is therefore DELIBERATELY NOT a required path here — asserting it would FAIL on a legitimately-null best-effort cycle. The runnable assertion is the REGRESSION FLOOR the [additive-keeps-score-byte-identical] invariant demands: the additive field must not perturb the score/tier/gate/fingerprint path, and market_state must stay the same envelope shape. The null-family states (charm-only, vanna-only, whole-read-null), byte-identity with-vs-without + before-vs-after the determinism fix (AC-11/AC-12), the horizon = next-monthly-OPEX derivation (AC-8), and the window-scoping/linear/pre-scaled arithmetic (AC-7) are verified off-harness by the BE runtime proofs + the FE test matrix. Uses SPY (a liquid ticker; fetch once before running, e.g. curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/ticker/SPY). Owner gate (2026-10-26, DESIGN.md Amendments): the endpoints marked _owner_gate read licence-derived data and answer the owner's account alone, so they are marked auth and this spec runs with --auth-cookie of an OWNER_EMAILS session. A --auth-signup user is not an owner and gets 403 owner_only; the refusals are asserted in public-surface.json (signed out) and auth-gated.json (signed in, not the owner).

endpoints._owner_gate: Owner gate (2026-10-26): owner only, since this read carries data computed from the licensed options feed. Run with --auth-cookie of an OWNER_EMAILS session; signed out is 403 auth_required (public-surface.json) and a signed-up non-owner is 403 owner_only (auth-gated.json).
